_README: THE ACKNOWLEDGED LISTS — G4418, 5 Oct 2026. check-c4-freshness.mjs fails on anything
UNCLASSIFIED: a built table that is no planned entry's builtAs, a served operation no
client in frontend/src/api or frontend/site/src/api reaches, and a client path no tier
declares. An entry here is a person saying 'yes, I know' in writing — and the gate also
fails on a STALE entry (a table no longer built, an operation no longer served or now
reached, a path no client sends), so the list cannot rot into a blanket exemption.
servedUnused: operationId -> why no browser client reaches it.
nonContractPaths: client path -> why it is not a plane operation.
tables: plane:schema.name -> the migration that built it.

servedUnused.admitRun: served (G694) and exercised by tests/http; no client in frontend/ names it
servedUnused.checkLocalHealth: the plane's own health check — its callers are ALBs and scrapers, never a person
servedUnused.completeInternalOnboardingStep: control-plane INTERNAL tier (S1, G4301–G4310): the data plane calls it signed with SigV4 and verified through sts:GetCallerIdentity (G4302); a browser never does (invariant 3) — G4444
servedUnused.forceInternalOnboardingStep: control-plane INTERNAL tier (S1, G4301–G4310): the data plane calls it signed with SigV4 and verified through sts:GetCallerIdentity (G4302); a browser never does (invariant 3) — G4444
servedUnused.getDispositionMix: served (G951–G954); no client in frontend/ names it — the /reports screen draws no mix yet
servedUnused.getInternalOnboarding: control-plane INTERNAL tier (S1, G4301–G4310): the data plane calls it signed with SigV4 and verified through sts:GetCallerIdentity (G4302); a browser never does (invariant 3) — G4444
servedUnused.getInternalRoster: control-plane INTERNAL tier (S1, G4301–G4310): the data plane calls it signed with SigV4 and verified through sts:GetCallerIdentity (G4302); a browser never does (invariant 3) — G4444
servedUnused.getMessage: correspondence read (G471); no client in frontend/ names it
servedUnused.getThread: correspondence read (G471); no client in frontend/ names it
servedUnused.grantRoleAssignment: served (G512); no client in frontend/ names it — there is no role-administration screen
servedUnused.listEntitledPacks: control-plane tier: a data plane pulls it, a browser never does (invariant 3)
servedUnused.listRunAllocations: served (R13, G2374); no client in frontend/ names it
servedUnused.listThreads: correspondence read (G471); no client in frontend/ names it
servedUnused.relayBrokerReturn: the broker's redirect target — a browser NAVIGATES to it inside a 303 chain, no client fetches it
